r.경제 체제: Mineral exports · bauxite, iron ore development
r.한국이 파는 것: Machinery, computers 37%, Cars 12%, Electronics, electrical equipment 10%, Steel products 7% (2025, share of value)
r.한국이 사는 것: Frozen fish 96%, Aluminum 1% (2025, share of value)
r.정치 구도: After a 2021 coup and a period of military rule, it held a presidential election in 2025.

t.why: It has some of the world's largest reserves of bauxite, the raw material for aluminum. A huge iron ore mine has also started up.
t.rel: A 2021 coup brought ECOWAS sanctions. With Liberia, Sierra Leone and Ivory Coast it forms the Mano River Union, and it has grown closer to the military government in neighboring Mali.
t.know: Africa has three countries with Guinea in their names: Guinea, Guinea-Bissau and Equatorial Guinea.
t.etext: It has the world's largest reserves of bauxite, the raw material for aluminum. Development of Simandou, one of the world's largest iron ore deposits, has begun and is expected to boost exports sharply.
